WHY CARRIERS BENEFIT FROM USING EQUINE DISPATCH

A platform that connects horse owners and carriers

Introduction

Equine Dispatch is a platform that connects horse owners who need to transport their horses with carriers who have available space on their trailers. Whether you have a fleet of 10 horse trailers or just a single horse trailer, Equine Dispatch is designed to help your business flourish. In this document, we will explain how Equine Dispatch can help you maximize your loads, increase your business, minimize your empty trips, and find reliable layovers.

Maximize Your Loads

Our goal is to help carriers maximize their loads. Far too often, we see carriers with massive 10 horse trailers driving around with one horse in it. We want to make each load you have more efficient by giving you the option of filling more spots per move. Having a better platform to see where horses are currently located and where they need to go along your route will help you optimize your capacity and reduce your costs.

Increase Your Business

Increased business is a main priority. Not only do we want to try and fill more spots on your trailer, but we also want to maximize the number of loads you can handle over the year by connecting you with our clients quickly. Equine Dispatch has a large network of horse owners who are looking for reliable and professional carriers to transport their horses. By signing up with us, you will have access to more opportunities and more revenue.

Minimize Your Empty Trips

We want to minimize the empty trips heading back home. A lot of horses are a one-way ticket. We want to try and give you the opportunity to pick something up when heading back home to help maximize your profits and potentially reduce the cost to the shipper. Equine Dispatch will alert you of any horses that need to be transported in the opposite direction of your destination, so you can make the most of your return trip.

Find Reliable Layovers

Layovers are important for the safety and well-being of both drivers and horses. Finding safe and reliable places to stop for the evening can be challenging and time-consuming. We want to be able to provide carriers with places they can stop to rest along their routes. Equine Dispatch has a list of layover facilities that offer quality services and amenities for you and your horses. You can book your layovers in advance outside of the platform.

Conclusion

Equine Dispatch is a platform that connects horse owners and carriers. Whether horse shipping is your main business or you do it as a side job, we encourage you to sign up with us. We need all of the high-quality carriers we can get on our platform. By using Equine Dispatch, you will benefit from maximizing your loads, increasing your business, minimizing your empty trips, and finding reliable layovers. Join us today and see how Equine Dispatch can help you grow your business.
